origin.dndsheets_species.acolyte.name: Acolyte
origin.dndsheets_species.acolyte.descrip: Served a temple, with Shelter of the Faithful, skilled in Insight and Religion.
origin.dndsheets_species.charlatan.name: Charlatan
origin.dndsheets_species.charlatan.descr: Con artist with a False Identity, skilled in Deception and Sleight of Hand.
origin.dndsheets_species.criminal.name: Criminal
origin.dndsheets_species.criminal.descri: Life outside the law, with a Criminal Contact, skilled in Deception and Stealth.
origin.dndsheets_species.entertainer.des: Lives to perform, By Popular Demand, skilled in Acrobatics and Performance.
origin.dndsheets_species.folk_hero.name: Folk Hero
origin.dndsheets_species.folk_hero.descr: Champion of the common folk, with Rustic Hospitality, skilled in Animal Handling and Survival.
origin.dndsheets_species.guild_artisan.d: Guild member, with Guild Membership, skilled in Insight and Persuasion.
origin.dndsheets_species.hermit.name: Hermit
origin.dndsheets_species.hermit.descript: Lived in seclusion, with a Discovery of their own, skilled in Medicine and Religion.
origin.dndsheets_species.noble.name: Noble
origin.dndsheets_species.noble.descripti: Privileged birth, with a Position of Privilege, skilled in History and Persuasion.
origin.dndsheets_species.outlander.name: Outlander
origin.dndsheets_species.outlander.descr: Raised in the wilds, a Wanderer, skilled in Athletics and Survival.
origin.dndsheets_species.sage.name: Sage
origin.dndsheets_species.sage.descriptio: Scholar and Researcher, skilled in Arcana and History.
origin.dndsheets_species.sailor.name: Sailor
origin.dndsheets_species.sailor.descript: Weathered by the sea, with a Ship's Passage, skilled in Athletics and Perception.
origin.dndsheets_species.soldier.name: Soldier
origin.dndsheets_species.soldier.descrip: Veteran with a Military Rank, skilled in Athletics and Intimidation.
origin.dndsheets_species.urchin.name: Urchin
origin.dndsheets_species.urchin.descript: Survived the streets, with City Secrets, skilled in Sleight of Hand and Stealth.
origin.dndsheets_species.fighter.name: Fighter
origin.dndsheets_species.fighter.descrip: Master of weapons and armor, with Second Wind.
origin.dndsheets_species.wizard.name: Wizard
origin.dndsheets_species.wizard.descript: Arcane scholar with a spellbook of their own and Arcane Recovery.
origin.dndsheets_species.rogue.name: Rogue
origin.dndsheets_species.rogue.descripti: Stealthy and deadly, strikes hard with Sneak Attack.
origin.dndsheets_species.cleric.name: Cleric
origin.dndsheets_species.cleric.descript: A channel for a god, healing and protecting with divine magic.
origin.dndsheets_species.paladin.name: Paladin
origin.dndsheets_species.paladin.descrip: Holy warrior who punishes with Divine Smite.
origin.dndsheets_species.barbarian.name: Barbarian
origin.dndsheets_species.barbarian.descr: Primal warrior who enters a Rage in combat.
origin.dndsheets_species.ranger.name: Ranger
origin.dndsheets_species.ranger.descript: Hunter and tracker, marks prey with Hunter's Mark.
origin.dndsheets_species.bard.name: Bard
origin.dndsheets_species.bard.descriptio: Versatile performer who inspires with Bardic Inspiration.
origin.dndsheets_species.druid.name: Druid
origin.dndsheets_species.druid.descripti: Guardian of nature, shapeshifts at will.
origin.dndsheets_species.warlock.name: Warlock
origin.dndsheets_species.warlock.descrip: Pact-based spellcaster whose slots recharge on a short rest.
origin.dndsheets_species.sorcerer.name: Sorcerer
origin.dndsheets_species.sorcerer.descri: Innate magic in the blood, shaped with Metamagic.
origin.dndsheets_species.monk.name: Monk
origin.dndsheets_species.monk.descriptio: Martial arts and discipline, strikes unarmed with mastery.
origin.dndsheets_species.human.name: Human
origin.dndsheets_species.human.descripti: Versatile and ambitious: +1 to all six abilities.
origin.dndsheets_species.elf.name: Elf
origin.dndsheets_species.elf.description: Agile and long-lived, with Fey Ancestry, Trance, and darkvision.
origin.dndsheets_species.dwarf.name: Dwarf
origin.dndsheets_species.dwarf.descripti: Tough and stone-wise, with Dwarven Resilience and Stonecunning.
origin.dndsheets_species.halfling.name: Halfling
origin.dndsheets_species.halfling.descri: Small and lucky: reroll 1s with Lucky, stand firm with Brave.
origin.dndsheets_species.dragonborn.name: Dragonborn
origin.dndsheets_species.gnome.name: Gnome
origin.dndsheets_species.gnome.descripti: Curious and clever, with Gnome Cunning against magic.
origin.dndsheets_species.half_elf.name: Half-Elf
origin.dndsheets_species.half_elf.descri: Between two worlds, with Fey Ancestry and Skill Versatility.
origin.dndsheets_species.half_orc.name: Half-Orc
origin.dndsheets_species.half_orc.descri: Strong and relentless, with Relentless Endurance and Savage Attacks.
origin.dndsheets_species.tiefling.name: Tiefling
origin.dndsheets_species.tiefling.descri: Of infernal lineage, with Hellish Resistance and Infernal Legacy.
